name: US midterms: every Senate and governor race, live county models in 13 states, House districts live
summary: Every Senate and governor race with live Polymarket and Kalshi prices and a polling average; in California, Texas, Georgia, South Carolina and Vermont a county-level model frozen before polls close (with and without polls) runs live against the markets on election night. Ohio has prices and polls only until its county baseline is in.

name: New Zealand general election
summary: A model frozen before polls close will follow the official count by electorate, project party votes and seats, and run live against Polymarket and Kalshi.

name: Taiwan: Taipei mayoral election 2026
summary: A model frozen before polls close will follow Taiwan's official CEC count by li, project all six candidates, and run live against Polymarket and Kalshi.

name: New Zealand general election 2023 (retrospective replay, simulated count order)
summary: Replay of the 2023 count in a simulated order. No market existed. The model favoured National from the start; settings from 2017 and 2020.

name: New Zealand general election 2020 (retrospective replay, simulated count order)
summary: Replay of the 2020 count in a simulated order. No market existed. Settings were tuned on this election (in sample).

name: Brazil presidential runoff
summary: From 1% counted (19:04), the model was already 90% sure of Lula's win, about 80 minutes before Polymarket (20:24); the raw tally showed Flávio Bolsonaro ahead from 19:45 to 20:23.

name: Brazil presidential election, first round
summary: From 1% counted (17:19), the model became 90% sure of Flávio Bolsonaro's first place at 18:02, about 28 minutes before Polymarket (18:30); the raw tally showed Lula ahead from 17:09 to 17:13.

name: Brazil governor runoffs (6 states)
summary: Counting from the moment each race reached 1% counted, the model was 90% sure of the winner a median 3 minutes after Polymarket (lead range -140 to +42 minutes across 6 governor runoffs); in 4 of 6 races Polymarket was already 90% sure before 1% was counted.

name: Brazil presidential election, first round
summary: From 1% counted (17:38), the model was already 90% sure of Lula's first place, 142 minutes before the raw tally settled on Lula (20:00); the raw tally showed Jair Bolsonaro ahead from 17:14 to 19:59. Model only: no market prices survive.

name: Brazil presidential runoff
summary: From 1% counted (17:14), the model became 90% sure of Lula's win at 18:41, 3 minutes before the raw tally settled on Lula (18:44); the raw tally showed Jair Bolsonaro ahead from 17:07 to 18:43. Model only: no market prices survive.

name: Israel, 26th Knesset election
summary: On the 6 contested Polymarket markets the count model settled a median 39 minutes before the market (5 of 6 first), but trailed by a median 28 minutes when made to wait for 1% counted; prices only, as the 2026 count over time cannot be published.

name: Canada federal election
summary: Market prices and official final results only; Elections Canada publishes no count over time. Polymarket was 90% sure the Liberals would win the most seats at 22:00 ET, when the last polls closed.

name: Netherlands, Tweede Kamer election
summary: Retrospective, not pre-registered; no count history exists, so this compares market prices with the final result only. Polymarket's D66 'most seats' price was 0.36 at 18:00 UTC, 0.86 when the exit poll came out at 20:00, fell to 0.54 by 00:07 UTC and stayed above 0.9 only from 00:59 UTC; the result was a 26-26 tie with PVV that D66 won on the alphabetical tie-break. A projection from the final polls made before any votes gave D66 24% and PVV 45%; from the 2023 result alone, D66 0.2%.

name: Quebec general election
summary: Market prices and official final results only. The 'most seats' and premier markets were above 0.9 before polls closed; 'PQ wins a majority' settled on no at 21:30 ET, when the official file showed the PQ leading in 60 seats, short of the 64 needed.

name: Mexico presidential election
summary: Polymarket was already 90% sure of Sheinbaum two days before the vote, so the count offered no trade. At 25% counted the model was 1.5 points below her final share (raw count 2.9 points), but its 90% intervals held the final share in only 10% of minutes.

name: Hungary, National Assembly election
summary: The district model projected Tisza's seats within one of the final from 22:30 and settled first on 13 of 20 contested markets (median lead 11.5 minutes), but the market's probabilities were far better overall and the trading rule lost $16,618 on $78,364 of real fills, almost all on one early seat-band bet.

name: Poland, presidential runoff
summary: Retrospective replay. With settings fixed on the 2025 round-1 night the model was 90% sure of Nawrocki's win at 23:28 CEST, 46 minutes before Polymarket (00:14), but its 90% band held the final share in only 46% of minutes; with settings from a simulated 2020 count it settled at 02:20, 126 minutes after the market.

name: Poland, presidential election, first round
summary: Retrospective replay. Polymarket had Trzaskowski at 95% to win the most votes when the count began and stayed above 90% from 03:46 CEST; the model, with settings fixed on a simulated 2020 count, settled at 05:16 CEST, 90 minutes later (its 90% band held the final share in 100% of minutes).

name: Germany, Bundestag election
summary: Retrospective replay from the Bundeswahlleiterin's archived night pages (15 national pages, 177 Wahlkreis pages). Polymarket was already above 0.9 on the outcome at poll close on 42 of 46 markets; on the 4 it had not settled, the count model settled first on 1 (BSW under 5%: +6 min) and its probabilities scored worse than the market's on 37 of 46.
